entities.summary: Katsumasa Kuroki is a Japanese professional wrestler, better known by his ring name Magnum Tokyo . Most closely associated with the now-defunct Toryumon Japan, he also competed for World Championship Wrestling, HUSTLE professional wrestling promotion and Dragon Gate as Tokyo Magnum and Magnum Tokyo. Magnum Tokyo was a architects & designers from Nerima (b. 1973-01-09, Nerima). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
